intro: 3.5 years of production physical design, plus the training and internship work that led into it. Reverse chronological, most recent first.

roles.summary: Owned implementation and signoff on taped-out blocks for external SoC customers, from floorplan through GDSII, across 7nm, 16nm and 14nm-class nodes.
highlights: Took blocks from netlist to GDSII at up to 3.7M instances and ~801 MHz, including feedthrough-heavy blocks with 13K–20K boundary pins.
Closed setup and hold across multi-corner PVT in PrimeTime and PrimeClosure, including timing ECOs and metal-only ECOs on signoff-bound data.

Diagnosed congestion and clock-tree problems at the root cause — module padding, partial placement and blockage, module redistribution, block-shape expansion, re-floorplanning and pin relocation — instead of applying one global fix.
Drove CTS debug on reg2reg and reg2icg paths with manual CTS, clock insertion-delay and latency tuning, clock-gating setup adjustments and ULVT library swaps.
Signed off DRC, LVS, ERC, PERC and FPPG in Calibre, and IR/EM in Voltus; ran early physical verification and post-route DRC to keep violations from reaching tape-out.
Wrote Tcl and AWK automation for repetitive checks, including a refinePlace location checker that caught ECO placements moving instances unexpectedly.
Mentored 2 interns, served as internship mentor lead, and authored the training plan and material for floorplan, preCTS, routing and the basic PD flow.

roles.summary: Entry into production physical design: flow fundamentals, scripting, and the handoff from RTL to layout.
highlights: Learned Tcl, AWK, Perl and C-shell scripting for design-flow automation.
Built working knowledge of CMOS devices and the VLSI flow from specification to fabrication.
Practised basic physical design steps under senior engineer review.

roles.summary: Selected for the Synopsys Fast Track Training Program; completed with a certificate of completion.
highlights: Ran the physical design flow in ICC2 as part of structured lab work.
Wrote RTL for a full adder and verified it in Verdi.
Covered scripting for flow automation and the IC design flow from specification to fabrication.
Awarded the Certificate of Completion, Synopsys Fast Track Training Program.
